updates.background_zh: A/I（Autistici/Inventati）是一个无政府主义技术集体，为活动人士和独立记者提供免费加密电子邮件和数字基础设施。与商业互联网公司不同的是，它明确带有政治立场、不以营利为目的，并以集体共识而非多数表决方式决策。此类服务对身处监控或压制下的人至关重要，但由于需要深度信任和持续的社区维护，因此十分稀缺。
updates.background_en: A/I (Autistici/Inventati) is an anarchist tech collective that provides free encrypted email and digital infrastructure to activists and independent journalists. Unlike commercial internet companies, it is explicitly political, non-profit, and makes decisions by consensus rather than majority voting. Services of this kind are vital for people operating under surveillance or repression, and they are rare because they require deep trust and continuous community maintenance.
updates.community_discussion_zh: 评论者的情绪混合着悲伤、愤怒与怀疑。有人说这一事件表明，一旦压力施加，一个团体从“中立客户”变成“负担”的速度有多快；还有人揶揄美国政府才是恐怖组织。另一些评论质疑事实前提，追问 A/I 的用户审查为何能构成“物质支持”指控的依据；还有人指出该团体在维基百科上的词条内容较为简略。
updates.community_discussion_en: Commenters express a mix of sadness, anger, and skepticism. One says the episode shows how quickly a group goes from neutral customer to liability once pressure is applied, while another sarcastically labels the US government a terrorist organization. Others challenge the factual premise, questioning how A/I's user vetting could support a material-support charge, and one points out that the group's Wikipedia article is light on detail.
